description: This file contains utility methods for AWS SDK interactions, including region endpoint resolution and DynamoDB key validation, with namespace determined by compile-time directives.

classes.name: AWSUtils
classes.description: A static utility class providing AWS-related helper methods for region resolution and DynamoDB key validation.

methods.name: GetRegionEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the AWS RegionEndpoint based on a system name or defaults to USWest2.

methods.name: ValidateDynamoDBPartitionKey
methods.description: Validates the length of a DynamoDB partition key, throws exception if too long.

methods.name: ValidateDynamoDBRowKey
methods.description: Validates the length of a DynamoDB row key, throws exception if too long.
